physics-killer-09.title: Imithetho kaNewton Yentshukumo kunye Nobudlelwane Obukhethekileyo
physics-killer-09.topic: Imithetho kaNewton Yentshukumo kunye Nobudlelwane Obukhethekileyo
physics-killer-09.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-09.material: Kwisenzo sokudityaniswa kwenyukliya $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$ ubunzima bendawo nganye: $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, i-neutron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. Amandla ahambelana ne-$1\,\mathrm{u}$ athathwa njenge $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$, kwaye amandla ehambayo amasuntswana ngaphambi kwesenzo ayalityalwa. Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa amandla akhutshwa kweso senzo $E$ kunye namandla ehambayo e-neutron, ukuba ubungakanani benani lentshukumo ye-$\mathrm{^4He}$ eyenziweyo kunye ne-neutron buyalingana kwaye umlinganiselo wobunzima uqikelelwa njenge-$4:1$?
physics-killer-09.thinking.0: Imithetho kaNewton Yentshukumo kunye Nobudlelwane Obukhethekileyo
physics-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: Kwisenzo sokudityaniswa kwenyukliya $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$ ubunzima bendawo nganye: $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, i-neutron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. Amandla ahambelana ne-$1\,\mathrm{u}$ athathwa njenge $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$, kwaye amandla ehambayo amasuntswana ngaphambi kwesenzo ayalityalwa. Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa amandla akhutshwa kweso senzo $E$ kunye namandla ehambayo e-neutron, ukuba ubungakanani benani lentshukumo ye-$\mathrm{^4He}$ eyenziweyo kunye ne-neutron buyalingana kwaye umlinganiselo wobunzima uqikelelwa njenge-$4:1$?
physics-killer-09.s.s1.explain: Kuba $\Delta m=5.0301-5.0101=0.0200\,\mathrm{u}$, $E=\Delta mc^2=0.0200\times930=18.6\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Kuba ubungakanani benani lentshukumo yamasuntswana amabini emva kwesenzo buyalingana, $K=\dfrac{p^2}{2m}\propto\dfrac1m$ kwaye $K_{He}:K_n=1:4$. Ngoko $K_n=\dfrac45\times18.6=14.88\approx14.9\,\mathrm{MeV}$, $K_{He}\approx3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Ukuba umlinganiselo ophikisanayo wobunzima ubhalwa ngokuphikisana, kuba $3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$ (impendulo engalunganga ②), ukuba amandla ahlulwa ngesiqingatha, ngumphendulo ongalunganga ③, ukuba $\Delta m$ ibalwa ngempazamo ngokuthi $0.0400\,\mathrm{u}$, ngumphendulo ongalunganga ④.
physics-killer-09.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-09.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
physics-killer-09.s.s1.hint.0: Ukunqongophala kobunzima $\Delta m=($ isenzo isixa sobunzima ngaphambi kwesenzo $)-($ isixa sobunzima emva kwesenzo $)$, amandla akhutshiweyo $E=\Delta m\,c^2$. Ukuba ubungakanani benani lentshukumo buyalingana, $K=p^2/(2m)$, ngoko amandla ehambayo aphikisana nobunzima.
